claims.text: Leaders of BRICS member states gathered in New Delhi, India, for an 11-nation BRICS summit.
The conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran had been ongoing for seven months at the time of the BRICS summit.
The United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia are BRICS member nations that have faced attacks from Iran.
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in New Delhi on September 11, 2026.

According to India's Ministry of External Affairs, Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need to protect freedom of navigation, commerce, and seafarer safety during talks with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin met for bilateral talks aimed at expanding annual bilateral trade to ₹100 billion by 2030.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that while a single currency remains under consideration, all BRICS members agree national currencies should be strengthened for member-state trade.
Russian President Vladimir Putin stated during a meeting with Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim that BRICS is forming the contours of a new, just, and democratic world order.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with UN Secretary-General António Guterres on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and UN Secretary-General António Guterres underscored the need to reform multilateral institutions, including the UN Security Council.
Masoud Pezeshkian is the first Iranian president to visit India in eight years.
Indian Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways Shantanu Thakur received Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian upon his arrival at the airport in New Delhi.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian proposed that BRICS establish a reinsurance company with an initial capital of $10 billion to cover risks for major infrastructure and energy projects.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with the President of Iran on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that BRICS countries contributed over 40 per cent of world GDP over the last five years, compared to 29 per cent from G7 countries.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin previously met on August 31, 2026, on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit in Bishkek.
Russian Embassy press secretary Petr Sizov spoke in fluent Hindi to reporters on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in Delhi.
